bio: Barathym is synonymous with good food in a casual, warm vibe, whether on the terrace or in the updated rustic village cafe interior. The tasty seasonal fare is traditional, although sprinkled with modernity, often in the form of Asian or Mediterranean accents. Don’t expect fussy plating, but rather the simple joy of a tender juicy cut of meat served with a crisp salad dressed in a spicy sauce. Good country cooking that our grandmothers would have been proud to serve adapted to today’s tastebuds and ethos. All of which at unbeatable eater-friendly prices!...
